verses.text: From Paul, called by God's will to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from our brother Sosthenes.

I write to God's church in Corinth. You have been made holy in Christ Jesus and called to be his holy people. I write also to everyone everywhere who calls on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours.
Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
I always thank my God for you, because of the grace he has given you in Christ Jesus.
In him you have been made rich in every way, in all your speaking and in all your knowledge.
This shows that what we told you about Christ has been made firm in you.
So you do not lack any gift as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to be shown to the world.
He will keep you strong to the end, so that no one can blame you on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
God is faithful. He called you to share life with his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
Brothers and sisters, I beg you in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to agree with each other. Do not split into groups. Be joined together, with the same mind and the same way of thinking.
My brothers and sisters, some people from Chloe's household have told me that you are quarrelling.
This is what I mean. One of you says, "I follow Paul." Another says, "I follow Apollos." Another says, "I follow Cephas." And another says, "I follow Christ."
Has Christ been divided? Was Paul nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptised in the name of Paul?
I thank God that I did not baptise any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
So no one can say that you were baptised in my name.
Oh yes, I also baptised the household of Stephanas. Apart from them, I do not remember baptising anyone else.
Christ did not send me to baptise, but to tell the good news. And I do not tell it with clever words, so that the cross of Christ does not lose its power.
The message of the cross seems foolish to those who are being lost. But to us who are being saved, it is the power of God.
The Scriptures say, "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will make the cleverness of clever people come to nothing."
So where is the wise person? Where is the teacher of the law? Where is the great debater of this world? God has shown that the wisdom of this world is foolish.
In his wisdom, God made sure the world could not know him through its own wisdom. Instead, God was pleased to save those who believe through the message we preach, which seems foolish.
Jews ask for signs, and Greeks look for wisdom.
But we preach Christ nailed to a cross. This is a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to non-Jews.
But to those whom God has called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God.
For God's foolishness is wiser than human wisdom, and God's weakness is stronger than human strength.
Brothers and sisters, think about what you were when God called you. Not many of you were wise by human standards. Not many were powerful. Not many came from important families.
But God chose what the world thinks is foolish to put the wise to shame. God chose what the world thinks is weak to put the strong to shame.
God chose what the world thinks is low and looked down on, and what counts for nothing, to bring to nothing what the world thinks is important.
So no one can boast before God.
It is because of God that you are in Christ Jesus. Christ has become wisdom from God for us. He makes us right with God, holy and free.
So, as the Scriptures say, "Whoever boasts should boast about the Lord."
